tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What this service is, whether payments are available, and on which networks a payment can be made (USDC, x402), with the smallest and largest payment.

tools.name: list_ad_formats
tools.description: The catalog: every ad format (PTC, Sponsored Listing, Banner, Native, Paid Visits) with its fields, limits, pricing models, minimum bids, minimum order, image rules and an example order with its price. Read this before building an order.

tools.name: quote_ad
tools.description: Validates an order and returns its exact price in USD with a breakdown. Creates nothing and costs nothing. An invalid order is answered with the code of the problem and the field it is in.

tools.name: create_ad
tools.description: Places an ad order. With an API key whose balance covers the price, it is paid from the balance. Otherwise the result is isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object for the exact price: sign it and call this tool again with the same order and the payment (in _meta["x402/payment"], or as payment_sig

tools.name: buy_ad_credit
tools.description: Buys prepaid ad credit at a fixed price: amount_usd in USDC, 1 USDC = $1.00 of credit (for example 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100). The first call returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object; call again with the signed payment. Without an API key the paid result carries api_key: the key of a new acc

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Creates an anonymous account with a zero balance and returns its API key, shown once. Only needed to upload an image before paying for anything (a Paid Visits ad needs one); otherwise use buy_ad_credit or create_ad, which create the account with the first payment.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Stores an image for a Paid Visits ad (required there) or a Banner ad (optional; PNG, JPEG or GIF of exactly one banner size, see list_ad_formats) and returns its id, to send as image_id in the order. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_ad
tools.description: One ad of the account: status (in_review, active, paused, rejected, completed, archived), spend, what remains, and the reason if it was rejected.

tools.name: get_ad_stats
tools.description: Delivery of one ad: totals and a daily series (impressions, clicks, visits, spend).

tools.name: pause_ad
tools.description: Pauses an active ad (Banner, Native, Paid Visits). Its budget stays reserved.

tools.name: resume_ad
tools.description: Resumes a paused ad: it serves again, within what is left of its budget.

tools.name: archive_ad
tools.description: Ends an ad for good (Banner, Native, Paid Visits). What it has not spent returns to the balance. It cannot be started again.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: The account's balance in USD: available, reserved by ads in review or live, and total.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_ad" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_balance · Private data: create_ad, buy_ad_credit, create_account, upload_image · Public sink: create_account, upload_image · Destructive: list_ad_formats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_balance · Private data: create_ad, buy_ad_credit, create_account, upload_image · Public sink: create_account, upload_image · Destructive: list_ad_formats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
